author.name: Horace Chan
author.headline: Expert in applying AI in verification

text:
Pre-AI, I study by taking notes, reading the textbook, doing homework, doing lab, taking exam, and finally learn the stuff after I finished the course and forgot all of it.

Post-AI, I study by asking the AI to generate the notes, generate the slides, chatting with it using those notes and slides, coding the labs, and ordering the AI to rewrite the vibe coded slop to implement exactly what I have in my mind.

The order is flipped: Now you learn it before you do it, and you won't realize you've learned the thing.

Pre-AI
1. Pick a topic from the course outline
2. Go to lecture
3. Take notes
4. Read the textbook
5. Do the homework
6. Do the lab
7. Take the exam
8. Take the final exam
9. Learn the stuff after you finished the course (and forgot all of it)

Post-AI
1. Ask AI to read the textbook and write the notes for you
2. Tell AI to create slides based on the notes
3. You chat with AI using the notes and slides, it's a learning by dialogue process
4. You chat with AI using the notes and code, the passive lecture is replaced with an active dialog, you keep asking questions until you understand the concept
5. Rebuild the vibe coded slop by ordering the AI to implement exactly what you have in your mind this time.
